model: An exact-population two-period AB/BAcrossover comparison. Both randomized sequence groups share one baseline. Bhas current-treatment effect0;Ahas an unknown additive current effect tau common to both periods. Period2has unknown additive shift delta. In period2the previous treatment adds an unknown carryover kappa_Aor kappa_B;there is no carryover in period1. No interaction,sequence-specific baseline or sampling noise is allowed in this controlled model.
target: From baseline records ALONE decide whether the current Aeffect is identified,and report it if identified,otherwise null. Decide whether ALL five parameters are identified. Select the least-cost single followup whose coefficient row makes all five parameters identified (all minimizers if tied),then use only that followup response to report the full parameter vector. A repeated contrast of existing means adds no independent constraint.
scope: Conditional linear-effect identifiability and measurement planning,not a real treatment recommendation or an uncertainty interval from four population means.
